business_problem: The IT team was challenged to accommodate the ambition and scale of this plan. For every new Novo Nordisk partner, the IT team had to provide new environments and access and follow compliance regulations.
solution_summary: Novo Nordisk scientists and engineers work at the frontiers of discovery to achieve their ultimate goal: defeating serious chronic diseases. The company’s researchers frequently collaborate with external teams, tracking as many as 50 million patients. They also work with a pharmaceutical value chain, enabling them to get Novo Nordisk innovative treatments and devices into the hands of patients who need them safely and efficiently. The IT team was challenged to accommodate the ambition and scale of this plan. For every new Novo Nordisk partner, the IT team had to provide new environments and access and follow compliance regulations. This manual, time-consuming effort slowed research productivity and decreased efficiency. More importantly, it constrained Novo Nordisk’s ability to look at patient data holistically.

data_flow: Project technical lead Roshan Thomas Mathew, Cloud Engineer and Lead for High Performance Computing (HPC), started with the data analysis requirements to define the research collaboration platform (RCP). It uses the Azure DevOps API and components, all while adhering to regulatory compliance requirements. RCP has reduced the time and effort required to set up and run segregated data and analytics projects, leading to increased efficiency and productivity.
business_outcome: RCP has reduced the time and effort required to set up and run segregated data and analytics projects, leading to increased efficiency and productivity. The ability to quickly share standard practices has also led to much better support for research teams.
